integrity: The dimensional equations were independently verified from the motivating full text. The proof is an exact generator identity plus invariant-measure integration and a support-rigidity argument; the source-parameter constants were replayed with exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem constrains compactly supported invariant measures in the nonnegative octant; it does not establish existence or stability of recurrent states.
The strict mean bound excludes non-equilibrium ergodic recurrent states from equality, but does not assert that the equilibrium equality case exists for arbitrary parameters.

Novelty was checked against the complete motivating article, the closest same-system predecessor inspected here, targeted web literature, and semantic database searches; an older equivalent under different notation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact trophic-budget parabola for stage-structured Beddington–DeAngelis recurrence
